identity.name: Baitadi Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: A prominent community-based campus affiliated with Tribhuvan University located in Dasharathchand, Baitadi.
identity.description: Baitadi Multiple Campus is a leading community higher education institution in the Baitadi district of Sudurpashchim Province, Nepal. Established in 1980, it offers undergraduate and education programs under the affiliation of Tribhuvan University, catering to the higher educational needs of students in the far-western region.
